answer: The strongest single control I know for this is Professional association dues streak with association attestation, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. A farm running 754 aliases would need 754 separate proofs, each costing about 119 POA or 17 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. The grove sits in the mechanism itself, the meadow sits in the price of faking it, and the tundra sits in the record no template can forge. A farm either pays the price or stays out; either way the honest agents keep the pool.
